item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.61

Released on 2026-11-17.

Received projects and the files they reach stay inside their own folder across render, preview and Studio, and a sealed preview reloads in place in a fraction of a second. This release also carries every change listed for 0.9.60. That version never reached npm: its publish was refused because it ran from the release PR's merge ref, and since #8020 a stable release publishes from the push to main that merges it.

Features

  • Engine: Render telemetry says why a page cannot reuse still frames (c8df284b2, #7993).
  • Studio: An element's source-parsed animations are part of Studio's API (efc91fc87, #8061).
  • Producer: Enforce expected output dimensions before capture (8a13b2caf, #7871).

Fixes

  • Producer, Parsers: Render compile never looks for a scene's assets on another computer (524ea46bf, #8063).
  • CLI: Refuse media-proxy copies another site asks for in play and the static server (f97e28905, #8058).
  • Producer: Readers re-check outside-linked compositions, and the refusal names a step every surface can take (4721739ee, #8034).
  • CLI: Leave files from outside the project out of Lambda and Cloud Run site uploads (39347da9d, #8060).
  • CLI: A host can name projects whose received files are expected or all received (5ea86450a, #8025).
  • Core: Only Studio's own preview pages get the editing port, and undo sets only safe attributes (55291c00c, #8057).
  • Lint: Match a timed wrapper's close tag literally (3e01f691d, #8028).
  • Studio: Each drag shows as its own undo step once its save lands (647bdd4d7, #8033).
  • CLI: A refused reverse start reports whether HeyGen sent the refusal (53080581c, #8053).
  • Producer: Cap a render's total sub-composition expansion (b29e40d70, #8045).
  • Inspector: The inspector's Chrome starts as root or in a container (f91bbf0da, #8050).
  • Refuse media paths that ffmpeg's image2 demuxer would read as a pattern (fe93f9cd4, #8047).
  • CLI: A project .env provider key gives way to the person's own credential (14c4e4c26, #8041).
  • CLI: Escape audio and media-use output, pin model files (c4439890c, #8013).
  • Producer: Keep the probe stage's media pre-checks linear in page size (e21f56dca, #8044).
  • Studio: Colour grading works in a sealed preview (d7d416124, #7999).
  • Engine: Bound the proxied host pre-check by the download's timeout (06b632017, #8048).
  • Engine: The GPU, host-ceiling and HDR launches keep the sandbox where the host allows it (7b27fbc84, #8038).
  • Studio Server: Cache reads never follow a link the project ships (70820b386, #8039).
  • Engine: Check proxied download hosts; keep raw GIF downloads private (5fcce21a6, #8040).
  • Skills: Locate.mjs reads the system font in place, not a shared /tmp copy (5b2990fc1, #8042).
  • Studio: Caption editing works in a sealed preview (915021265, #8002).
  • Producer: Cap the software encoder to the cores capture leaves free (f89f6d3d4, #8019).
  • Studio: A sealed preview's reload shows in a fraction of a second, not after 8 s (9daa7e876, #8015).
  • Skills: Run bundled TTS helpers from the skill folder, not the working directory (6115945cf, #8035).
  • A received-files record follows Studio renames, moves and deletes, and a nested record can't be moved out of reach (f5bb3e551, #7989).
  • Studio Server: A loopback page with no fetch metadata is marked unless the app framed it (b6e1e8dda, #8017).
  • Studio: The copied render command carries no composition text a shell can run (19743ea09, #8012).
  • The dev Studio's renders follow the received-project rule, and a received project's .env keys never replace the person's own (8239fe470, #8004).
  • Producer: Trusted renders refuse outside-linked compositions unless --include-outside-files (00d03a412, #8024).
  • Studio Server: Audio decodes are bounded, stop when nobody waits, and their cache is capped (5f6995fe7, #7991).
  • Studio: A modal opened from a popover or menu closes first on Escape (c8235f123, #7976).
  • Engine: GPU probe, HDR capture and host-ceiling probe keep a required sandbox (fb5f9e52c, #8018).
  • CLI: Render --docker applies the received-project rule on the host (e58fb3249, #8016).
  • Studio: An undo on a sealed preview shows in place, not after a reload (fee03bfbe, #8009).
  • CLI: Files from outside the project are uploaded only once approved (22b615f1a, #7995).
  • CLI: Compare and keyframes --shot serve only the files a bare HTML file names (346579b6b, #8006).
  • Preview image prep reads no HEIC or GIF outside the project unless render would (f880693cf, #8001).
  • Engine: The playlist folder check reads colon, query and fragment names as ffmpeg resolves them (38aaad1b2, #8014).
  • Studio Server: Bound preview stills and keep proxy work to the Studio's own pages (bffe8d598, #8007).
  • Producer: Local renders leave out scripts from outside the project unless included (581a43bb6, #7998).
  • CLI: Only the Studio's own origin may frame the Studio page (02c1fb48e, #8000).
  • Producer: Linear probe media check, and renders refuse composition HTML over 16 MB (d53b6059b, #7992).
  • Studio Server: History writes and claims follow Studio's write rule (32fe10a8b, #7988).
  • CLI: Error boxes and command failure lines print control characters as visible escapes (5979991d5, #7987).

Internal

  • Publish: A stable release needs a maintainer's approval, not any account's (4807799c4, #8062).
  • Raise the producer packed-size budget to 936,000 bytes (909a9b183, #8054).
  • Publish a stable release from the push that merges its release PR (5f6007ffc, #8020).
  • Publish: A prerelease tag publishes only to an allow-listed dist-tag (9fae4ffd8, #7963).
  • CLI: A received project's preview still converts a photo inside it (0ad24ba83, #8021).

Full changelog

item.title: v0.9.59
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.59

Released on 2026-11-16.

The preview player gets a fullscreen button, and a failed render now says why. Renders, Studio and the CLI keep to the project's own files and to public media hosts.

Features

  • CLI: Diff --hide scores a project's layer by what it adds (e6d5c699b, #7972).
  • Player: Add a fullscreen button to the preview player (5be6c1580, #7726).
  • Core: Describe replies carry the picker's element label, and studio exports standInHandle (51ae92510, #7936).

Fixes

  • Hidden and credential files stay out of Studio, history and lint (c68c78445, #7979).
  • Core: A page marked for another site gives that site only playback (c4d607c7f, #7980).
  • Studio Server: No write route touches files other tools run or trust (2a28e4368, #7964).
  • CLI: The skills update check never reads a project's git config (e368db138, #7975).
  • Lint: Run Studio and producer lint off the host's own thread (778a00564, #7974).
  • Producer: Probe sub-composition media defaults (95e4e7f88, #7550).
  • CLI: Validate and keyframes print project text with control characters as visible escapes (ce8d55d30, #7958).
  • Check: A media source that failed to load is not reported as a timeout (5e0c3db12, #7954).
  • CLI: Help shows each option's default once (d7f8d77fb, #7953).
  • CLI: Render --json gives each missing tool, a held slot and an old Node its own code (47d007e5b, #7842).
  • Sdk Playground: The Vite config loads on Node 22 before 22.18 (c7876f333, #7805).
  • Check: Mark a contrast finding by its severity and quote its text (ec5a4e2a1, #7752).
  • Player: The fix for the preview freezing when many clips share one long recording is pulled from this release, because it stopped an app embedding the preview from showing an edit (42508c1ef, #7795; reverted by 33e1a36a3, #7978).
  • Snapshot skips private files, no text-art demuxers, escaped warning text (8959deb00, #7943).
  • CLI: Capture names its local page server's port in the bypass entry (a9b0371c8, #7965).
  • CLI: A render that fails says why, even on a crash or a silent exit (2623ded13, #7957).
  • Studio: A long audio file from outside the project is never decoded for its waveform (c77cd301c, #7961).
  • Publish: Upload only what npm reads as checked; tags publish only main, next or alpha commits (5f4637977, #7959).
  • Engine: Media URL reads reach only public hosts under a restricted page network (994fbbde2, #7946).
  • Cli,engine: Pin the page server's direct host to an explicit port and the Studio's own origin (dbc9c1826, #7945).
  • Producer: A render waiting on a long audio mix says it is processing audio (df698a029, #7952).
  • Core: A capture page loads a clip with no set length only when it is due (9e5048772, #7938).
  • Studio: Beat analysis never picks a recording longer than a song (87955b890, #7944).
  • CLI: Own render-slot lock dir; refuse cache files other accounts can write (071a2da0b, #7951).
  • CLI: Never write project records through symlinks under .hyperframes (061ff5bbb, #7950).

Docs & Examples

  • Changelog: Weekly digest 2026-11-09-2026-11-16 (af873924d, #7969).
  • Publish: Say publishing waits for no approval and only admins push prerelease tags (a707e4737, #7960).

Catalog

  • CLI: Escape control characters in project, page and registry text (6f88be394, #7913).
  • Mcp: Run the MCP registry publish in the mcp-registry environment (45ff3526c, #7966).
  • Ci: A catalog publish run that main overtook ends clean instead of failing (77e675574, #7816).

Other Changes

Full changelog

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.58

Released on 2026-11-16.

Studio exports a sealed preview's checked element reads and stand-ins, and renders, carve and the audio engine keep to the project's own files. This release also carries everything prepared as v0.9.57, which never reached npm.

Features

  • Studio: A sealed preview frame forwards Studio's playback keys (b741ecf13, #7844).
  • CLI: Show and open the page to manage or cancel a paid plan (b2e6076b7, #7784).
  • Studio: Export a sealed preview's checked element reads and stand-ins (a0848ad35, #7918).

Fixes

  • CLI: Check and info never probe a composition's remote media URLs (78648113d, #7942).
  • CLI: Open starts the desktop app in the home folder, not the folder it runs in (a2e7306b2, #7937).
  • CLI: Studio thumbnails and Ctrl-C cleanup under a restricted page network (707e20f18, #7941).
  • Studio Server: A host that built a page on the build worker can exit (e8f1fff5f, #7939).
  • CLI: Commands that open a composition honor PRODUCER_RESTRICT_PAGE_NETWORK (49e9424ba, #7935).
  • Engine,producer,cli: Media inputs refuse formats that open other files (ead110aab, #7931).
  • Engine: Check the resolved address of a restricted download under Bun too (04b690361, #7860).
  • Parsers: Bound total expansion in the GSAP timeline inliner (aed28486f, #7930).
  • Nested .hyperframes stays private, capture page server checks Host, project manifests pin no CLI (d5f0b1a5b, #7927).
  • Studio Server: Sub-composition previews build off the request thread within a deadline (d159ec51c, #7857).
  • Publish: A first release attempt no longer fails looking for an artifact a retry would reuse (9f85cf0a2, #7929).
  • Player: The Safari audio check no longer flakes on a clean ten-take play (916bcc83a, #7685).
  • Core: A color-graded video's dissolve and wipe play in preview and export (889143eac, #7756).
  • Media Use: The carve bundle exports analyseCarveDynamics, so carve runs again (94e499d8c, #7893).
  • Parsers: Past 10,000 identical elements every id is still unique (472909914, #7919).
  • Producer: The plan copy checks every project entry, whatever its name (7aaeb9371, #7906).
  • Producer: Render compile never inlines private project files named by @font-face (209477b65, #7925).
  • Studio: The preview picture takes its box's size in the same frame, scaled or not (1e040f6fe, #7907).
  • Engine,producer: Render media readers skip private project files and text-art input (6411df4e3, #7928).
  • Media Use: Carve runs its own copy of core's analysis, never the project's (25c603521, #7926).
  • Studio: A host that shows a still gets a preview reload with one page at a time (dab8dc807, #7905).
  • Warnings that name project files print control characters as visible escapes (d42bbd67f, #7863).
  • Studio: Recovery drafts are kept by each project's own server, never the browser (2be03408d, #7904).
  • Media Use: Audio engine reads and writes only inside the project folder (c2c6d8c59, #7897).
  • CLI: Batch outputs from a template that starts with a placeholder stay in the working folder (cf44c60cd, #7868).

Docs & Examples

  • Skills: Style-sampling pulls the template every time, so a received copy is checked first (d796fd59e, #7924).

Internal

  • Skills: Read the ClawHub token from the main-only clawhub environment (5d5e2c062, #7923).
  • Studio Server: Give tests the CLI's 20 s ceiling so a busy CI runner stops timing them out (8ec98be29, #7933).
  • Engine: Browser pool tests never start the host's cached Chrome (cadcdb955, #7759).
  • Publish: Publish only tarballs npm reads the way the check does (dac0468f7, #7922).
  • Publish: Bind Lambda release retries to immutable run artifacts (8e8eeb205, #7920).
  • Publish: The release keeps only Lambda assets npm pins or this run built (11a7d2749, #7880).

Full changelog

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.37

Released on 2026-11-12.

Sharing refuses to build an archive when it can't read .hyperframesignore, so ignored files stay out. templates pull also refuses archives that hold links.

Fixes

  • CLI: hyperframes templates pull refuses an archive that holds anything other than plain files and folders, such as a symlink, hard link or device entry. Nothing is unpacked, and no partial folder is left behind. A link inside a pulled template could otherwise let preview, render and publish reach files elsewhere on your machine (ab66e5bd7, #7576).
  • Share: snapshotProject and snapshotFiles throw invalid_source_ignore again when .hyperframesignore can't be read. In 0.9.35 they skipped the unreadable file, so an archive built from the snapshot could include files the ignore file meant to leave out. Hosts that use these functions only for change detection should pass { lenientIgnore: true } to keep the 0.9.35 behavior. projectFingerprint already does (35cf03cab, #7573).

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.35

Released on 2026-11-11.

  • Studio Server: When a file is still changing, a claim waits for its first copy, so the edit can still be undone (248f56fba, #7497).

HyperFrames v0.9.17

Released on 2026-11-05.

Set HF_VIDEO_FRAME_WINDOW=true with segmented capture and a long render holds far less on disk. Each segment extracts only the frames it shows, then deletes them. Segmented capture also checks drawElement frames against their reference samples now, and check --budget stops a whole check in time.

Features

  • Producer: Render long videos with windowed source frames behind a flag (968f97fe9, #7242).
  • Producer: A capture segment extracts the frames it shows and deletes them (599eaad2b, #7241).
  • CLI: Check --budget stops the whole check in time and reports what it found (b7d72c947, #7245).
  • CLI: Info --media lists every clip the render hears, on the film's clock (df54f380c, #7235).

Fixes

  • CLI: Check judges SVG gradient text by its gradient stops, not as black (478ef2f26, #7258).
  • Engine: Name a failed script's origin and error before the free text of its warning (7290ee68c, #7256).
  • CLI: Normalize-audio --reference stops short of the peak ceiling instead of refusing (2f2195515, #7254).
  • Producer: Segmented and sequential capture check drawElement samples (8df4f21c2, #7255).
  • Core: Two scenes drawing SVGs with the same ids each show their own (b108f8512, #7251).
  • CLI: End a stalled cloud upload and send it again (f98218a22, #7237).
  • Core: Decode WebKit sources by memory budget, not by length (600bfa451, #7232).
  • Core: Snapshot and preview show a clip on the frame render shows it (5377b756b, #7238).
  • Producer: An export over the peak ceiling loses only what it must (d40d0b251, #7246).
  • Lint: Every selector in a comma list counts as hidden by authored CSS (a664f99ec, #7252).
  • Core: The bundle's contract check reads a timeline registered in a local script (0b3559824, #7248).
  • CLI: Check sees an SVG stroke drawing on, so it no longer calls it a dead stretch (644b166e7, #7250).
  • CLI: An unknown command answers in a few lines and says what to run instead (0a6746e1d, #7247).
  • CLI: Lint says nothing when the OS refuses to lower its priority (c1977fab3, #7244).
  • Lint: Compositions in .hyperframesignore no longer count as the project's (80e02e74a, #7239).
  • CLI: Name the network cause of a failed fetch in the error box (f55990ebc, #7236).
  • Core: Hlg footage tone-maps to sdr at the bt.2408 reference white (5ee9e928d, #7234).

Internal

  • Producer: Deferred frame extraction moves out of the distributed code (35cbca992, #7240).

Released on 2026-11-04.

Cloud renders no longer fail on common font styles, and they now carry the system fonts a project uses. A wedged render stops itself, and check no longer hangs on long videos.

  • CLI: Cloud render carries the system fonts a project uses in its zip (cba66f20a69c9, #7165).

Fixes

  • CLI: Tell a failed billing checkout apart from a payment not finished in time (60ca970ed60df, #7185).
  • Fonts: Stop failing cloud renders on var() shorthands, font-X-400 names and linked font sheets (af0c815c72b14, #7166).
  • CLI: Check copies only the stretch of a video it plays and stops after 2 minutes of copies (c6f87f59b0c9a, #7182).
  • CLI: Report why a reverse session could not be recorded (21e2038595047, #7186).
  • CLI: Check thins its craft samples when frames are slow, so the pass ends near 90 seconds (be8122d0c4054, #7183).
  • CLI: A command waiting on the project lock says what it waits for (00ea86570a8c8, #7184).
  • Engine: A background image that never finishes decoding no longer stalls the frame (73e65e2c7826b, #6972).
  • CLI: A track with no beats answers an empty result, not an error (cffd70f2f9b24, #7173).
  • Core: A logo image no longer renders stretched to the frame bottom (3d78ac0fa6671, #7179).
